ctx.x: Now, I remember the first time I got turned on was Big Matlock [Big Matlock] turned me on, you know. And do you know how we met? In the music store. And everybody... Well, he was the first one that played the... First he had the play the record of Louis ...(?)..., and I can play the song to this day. We were in this music store in Omaha, Nebraska, with that show, that TOBA show there... He heard us humming the thing, and he said, "Are you guys musicians?" "Yeah." He said, "I'm from Chicago," and he asked if I'd…
